findings.text: the `core_plasma_physics` → `plasma_state` description is defined as covering "densities, temperatures, pressures, velocities, current densities, fields, energies, composition … wherever it applies" and explicitly "neutral or edge quantities with no core locus", while the surviving `edge_plasma_physics` ("Scrape-off layer, divertor physics, plasma-wall interactions, recycling"), `divertor_physics` ("Divertor target loads, detachment, particle and heat exhaust") and `plasma_wall_interactions` ("First wall … erosion, deposition, material migration") descriptions are left untouched; the same section constrains only the transport/origin boundary and says nothing about an edge/SOL density, temperature or neutral pressure that fits both, so the downstream re-domaining of the 310 names this plan counts cannot pick a domain deterministically
